description: One PRA response per band, simulated with frequency-independent absorption at the GRAP values of that band (1e6 rays, 0.5 m receiver, room-wide scattering 0.0195, 44.1 kHz, ISM order 3 with the maximum order counted once, no air attenuation), evaluated once with CHORAS's calculate_room_acoustic_parameters in the octave band and once broadband with otherwise identical processing (start detection on the broadband signal, pyrato EDC). Units: s, s, dB, %, ms.
